interpretation.plain_speak: The bounded two-refresh rule is not an artifact of the original four hand positions: it prevented 22 additional losses across 48 new starting hands, for 29 prevented losses out of 64 total under no-refresh pressure at cadence 2. It still does not generalize to the other pressure policies.
interpretation.north_star_question: Establishes state-space transfer of a bounded corrective effect; the next unresolved issue is whether Wingless's warning timing is itself useful or whether any two early targeted refreshes would do the same job.
interpretation.next_stage: compare warning-triggered two-shot targeted refresh against an equal-budget fixed-early targeted schedule and sham control on the expanded state space
